sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Stock status and catalogue visibility no longer drift apart.** When `woocommerce_hide_out_of_stock_items` is enabled, WooCommerce hides products carrying the `product_visibility` `outofstock` term. That term is added when a SKU drops to zero (via `zero_out_product()`'s `WC_Product->save()`), but the low-level `update_product()` path that brings a SKU back in stock only rewrote the `_stock_status` meta and never cleared the term — so a returning product stayed invisible on the storefront despite reading as in stock. `update_product()` now syncs the term with the new status (mirroring WooCommerce's own rule that the term exists only while the hide option is on), removing it on return to stock and adding it on a drop to zero, without falling back to a full `save()`. `create_product()` had the mirror gap — a freshly imported zero-stock SKU was left visible — and now tags it `outofstock` the same way. A one-shot upgrade routine (`resync_hidden_instock_visibility()`, run once on version bump) clears the stale term from every already-affected product in a single query and recounts the term natively, so updating the plugin restores their visibility automatically.
